words.gloss: from the employment of secret agents
agents in the guise of holy men
with the spell of putting to sleep, concealment and door-removal

hindi: गुप्तचरों के प्रयोग के बाद सिद्ध के वेश वाले गुप्तचर माणव विद्याओं से युवकों को, प्रस्वापन, अन्तर्धान और द्वार-अपोह मन्त्र से प्रतिरोधकों को, संवदन मन्त्र से पारतल्पिकों को लुभाएँ।
english: After the employment of secret agents, agents in the guise of holy men should tempt young men with māṇava sciences, robbers with the spell of putting to sleep, concealment and door-removal, [and] adulterers with the saṃvadana spell.
notes: māṇava-vidyā: "sciences of young men / māṇava sciences" is literal; the exact sense is unclear, so māṇava is kept in the English. saṃvadana (literally "speaking together, accord") is kept untranslated; its sense is not guessed. dvāra-apoha = "removal of doors" (alternative: opening of doors). pāratalpika is rendered "adulterer" (literally one who goes to another's bed). The listed spells are read as a dvandva (putting to sleep, concealment, door-removal) before mantra; the e-text dots in antar.dhāna are kept as members. Verb and the three objects are matched in order with the three spells.
lines_deva: सत्त्रि.प्रयोगाद् ऊर्ध्वं सिद्ध.व्यञ्जना माणवान् माणव.विद्याभिः प्रलोभयेयुः, प्रस्वापन.अन्तर्.धान.द्वार.अपोह.मन्त्रेण प्रतिरोधकान्, संवदन.मन्त्रेण पारतल्पिकान्
lines_iast: sattri.prayogād ūrdhvaṃ siddha.vyañjanā māṇavān māṇava.vidyābhiḥ pralobhayeyuḥ, prasvāpana.antar.dhāna.dvāra.apoha.mantreṇa pratirodhakān, saṃvadana.mantreṇa pāratalpikān

hindi: उत्साह जगाए हुए उनके एक बड़े समूह को लेकर, रात में एक गाँव का निर्देश करके, कृत्रिम स्त्री-पुरुषों वाले दूसरे गाँव में जाकर वे कहें — “यहीं विद्या का प्रभाव दिखाया जाए, दूसरे गाँव में जाना कठिन है।”
english: Taking a great crowd of them, whose enthusiasm has been produced, at night, having indicated one village, [and] having gone to another village with artificial women and men, they should say: “Let the might of the science be seen right here; the other village is difficult to go to.”
notes: The construction anyaṃ grāmam uddiśya … anyaṃ grāmaṃ … gatvā is read as "having indicated one village … having gone to another village"; the first anya could also be "some other" (than the village they are in). kṛtaka (literally "made, artificial") is taken as staged or feigned, but the purpose is not stated; the text does not say. kṛta-utsāha is literal ("enthusiasm made"); utsāha = energy/enthusiasm. saṅgha here is an ordinary crowd, not the political saṅgha. para-grāma could also be "the village of others". eva after iha is emphatic ("right here").
lines_deva: तेषां कृत.उत्साहानां महान्तं सङ्घम् आदाय रात्राव् अन्यं ग्रामम् उद्दिश्य-अन्यं ग्रामं कृतक.स्त्री.पुरुषं गत्वा ब्रूयुः - "इह-एव विद्या.प्रभावो दृश्यतां, कृच्छ्रः पर.ग्रामो गन्तुम्" इति
lines_iast: teṣāṃ kṛta.utsāhānāṃ mahāntaṃ saṅgham ādāya rātrāv anyaṃ grāmam uddiśya-anyaṃ grāmaṃ kṛtaka.strī.puruṣaṃ gatvā brūyuḥ - "iha-eva vidyā.prabhāvo dṛśyatāṃ, kṛcchraḥ para.grāmo gantum" iti

hindi: तब द्वार-अपोह मन्त्र से द्वारों को हटाकर वे कहें — “प्रवेश किया जाए।”
english: Then, having removed the doors with the door-removal spell, they should say: “Let it be entered.”
notes: apohya from apa-√ūh is rendered literally "having removed"; the result may be read as "opened", but the text only says removed. praviśyatām is an impersonal passive, "let it be entered" (that is, "enter").
lines_deva: ततो द्वार.अपोह.मन्त्रेण द्वाराण्य् अपोह्य "प्रविश्यताम्" इति ब्रूयुः
lines_iast: tato dvāra.apoha.mantreṇa dvārāṇy apohya "praviśyatām" iti brūyuḥ

hindi: अन्तर्धान मन्त्र से जागते हुए पहरेदारों के बीच से युवकों को पार करवाएँ।
english: With the concealment spell, they should make the young men pass through the middle of the waking guards.
notes: madhyena (instrumental of madhya) is used as "through the middle of" with the genitive.
lines_deva: अन्तर्.धान.मन्त्रेण जाग्रताम् आरक्षिणां मध्येन माणवान् अतिक्रामयेयुः
lines_iast: antar.dhāna.mantreṇa jāgratām ārakṣiṇāṃ madhyena māṇavān atikrāmayeyuḥ

words.gloss: with the spell of putting to sleep
should cause to be moved about

hindi: प्रस्वापन मन्त्र से पहरेदारों को सुलाकर शय्याओं सहित उन्हें युवकों द्वारा चलवाएँ।
english: Having put the guards to sleep with the spell of putting to sleep, they should have [them] moved about with [their] beds by the young men.

text_flags.why: śayā is not a known word; śayyā (bed) expected, single y may be a typing slip (possible)

notes: śayā (f. inst. pl.) is read as "bed" (the usual form is śayyā); the reading "moved about together with the beds" is a medium-confidence reading: the instrumental śayābhiḥ may be accompaniment (with the beds). The object of sañcārayeyuḥ is taken to be the guards. Alternative: the young men are the ones moved about. The Hindi and English words "them" and "their" are supplied (English in brackets).
lines_deva: प्रस्वापन.मन्त्रेण प्रस्वापयित्वा रक्षिणः शयाभिर् माणवैः सञ्चारयेयुः
lines_iast: prasvāpana.mantreṇa prasvāpayitvā rakṣiṇaḥ śayābhir māṇavaiḥ sañcārayeyuḥ

words.gloss: those in the guise of wives

hindi: संवदन मन्त्र से दूसरों की पत्नियों के वेश वाली गुप्तचर स्त्रियों को युवकों के साथ आनन्दित करवाएँ।
english: With the saṃvadana spell, they should cause female agents in the guise of wives of others to rejoice together with the young men.
notes: Doubtful construction. bhāryā-vyañjanāḥ is read as an accusative plural feminine object (female agents in the guise of wives), following the glossary rendering of X-vyañjanā. pareṣām is read with bhāryā-vyañjanāḥ ("wives of others"); alternative: pareṣām māṇavaiḥ = "with the young men of others", or bhāryā-vyañjanāḥ as nominative (the female agents themselves cause the young men to rejoice). The verb sammodayeyuḥ is the causative of sam-√mud; its exact sense (take pleasure, consort) is kept literal. Reviewer: pareṣām cannot grammatically qualify the first member of the compound bhāryā-vyañjanāḥ; the adjacent reading 'with the young men of others' (pareṣām māṇavaiḥ), or bhāryā-vyañjanāḥ as nominative subject, is at least as natural as the draft. Rendering left literal; a person should decide.

words.gloss: of those who have perceived the might of the science

hindi: जिन्होंने विद्या के प्रभाव का अनुभव कर लिया है, उन्हें पुरश्चरण आदि का आदेश दें, पहचान के लिए।
english: They should prescribe puraścaraṇa and the like to those who have perceived the might of the science, for recognition.
notes: puraścaraṇa (literally "going before") is kept untranslated; it is a preliminary observance. The genitive upalabdha-vidyā-prabhāvāṇām is taken as "to those who ..." with ādiśeyuḥ. upalabdha can also be "obtained, found out". abhijñāna = recognition, identification.

words.gloss: in (those) with goods on which marks have been made

hindi: अथवा जिन घरों में वस्तुओं पर चिह्न लगा दिया गया हो, उनमें कर्म करवाएँ।
english: Or they should have the action done in houses in which the goods have been marked.
notes: karma is rendered "action" (the glossary rendering); it presumably means the act of theft, but the text does not say so. The bahuvrīhi kṛta-lakṣaṇa-dravya agrees with veśmasu.

hindi: अथवा अनुप्रवेश करके एक स्थान पर पकड़वाएँ।
english: Or, having entered in, they should cause [them] to be seized in one place.
notes: The object of grāhayeyuḥ is not stated; "them" is supplied in brackets in English. anupraviṣṭāḥ (anu-pra-√viś) = having entered after or along (with the others); the Hindi keeps the verbal sense "entering".

words.gloss: in the buying, selling and pledging of goods that have been marked

hindi: अथवा जिन वस्तुओं पर चिह्न लगा दिया गया हो, उनके क्रय, विक्रय और बन्धक में योग-सुरा से मत्त हुओं को पकड़वाएँ।
english: Or they should have those seized who are intoxicated by yoga-liquor at the buying, selling and pledging of goods that have been marked.
notes: yoga-surā: yoga (here probably a drugging contrivance or mixture) is kept untranslated; the sense is not settled, and the compound could also be "intoxicated by liquor and yoga". ādhāna = deposit, pledge. The compound is read as a dvandva of kraya, vikraya and ādhāna after the bahuvrīhi kṛta-lakṣaṇa-dravya.

hindi: पकड़े गए लोगों से पहले के कृत्यों के साथियों के विषय में पूछताछ करे।
english: He should question those who have been seized about the accomplices in [their] earlier exploits.
notes: Double accusative: the seized (person) and the accomplices (matter). pūrva-apadāna-sahāyān is read as a tat-puruṣa "accomplices in earlier exploits"; alternative: a dvandva "earlier exploits and accomplices". apadāna = deed, exploit.

words.gloss: agents in the guise of old thieves

hindi: अथवा पुराने चोरों के वेश वाले गुप्तचर चोरों में प्रविष्ट होकर उसी प्रकार कर्म करवाएँ और पकड़वाएँ।
english: Or agents in the guise of old thieves, having entered among the thieves, should in just the same way have the action done and have [them] seized.
notes: purāṇa = old (alternative: former). The object of grāhayeyuḥ is not stated ("them" is bracketed in English). "In just the same way" refers back to the earlier units (8 to 9).
lines_deva: पुराण.चोर.व्यञ्जना वा चोरान् अनुप्रविष्टास् तथा-एव कर्म कारयेयुर् ग्राहयेयुश् च
lines_iast: purāṇa.cora.vyañjanā vā corān anupraviṣṭās tathā-eva karma kārayeyur grāhayeyuś ca

words.gloss: to the citizens and country people

hindi: पकड़े गए लोगों को समाहर्ता पौर और जानपदों को दिखाए — “राजा चोर पकड़ने की विद्या का अध्ययन करता है, उसके उपदेश से ये चोर पकड़े गए हैं और मैं फिर पकड़ूँगा; तुम्हारे पापाचरण वाले स्वजन को रोका जाना चाहिए।”
english: The Collector should show those who have been seized to the citizens and country people: “The king studies the thief-catching science; by his instruction these thieves have been seized, and I shall seize again. Your own kinsman of evil conduct is to be restrained.”

text_flags.why: h for visarga (ḥ); the "-" before the closing quotation mark is the e-text's unsandhied join with the following iti

notes: The Hindi and English supply "the king" as subject of adhīte as printed (rājā nominative). sva-jana is taken as "own kinsman" (literally own person/people); singular, so "your own person of evil conduct" is also possible. The quotation is opened and closed within the unit. The closing iti is not rendered.
lines_deva: गृहीतान् समाहर्ता पौर.जानपदानां दर्शयेत् - "चोर.ग्रहणीं विद्याम् अधीते राजा, तस्य-उपदेशाद् इमे चोरा गृहीताः, भूयश् च ग्रहीष्यामि, वारयितव्यो वः स्व.जनः पाप.आचारह्-" इति
lines_iast: gṛhītān samāhartā paura.jānapadānāṃ darśayet - "cora.grahaṇīṃ vidyām adhīte rājā, tasya-upadeśād ime corā gṛhītāḥ, bhūyaś ca grahīṣyāmi, vārayitavyo vaḥ sva.janaḥ pāpa.ācārah-" iti

words.gloss: on the information of a spy
of yoke-pins, goads and the like

hindi: और जिसे यहाँ गुप्तचर की सूचना से शम्या, प्रतोद आदि का चोर जाने, उसे इनमें से निर्दिष्ट करे — “यह राजा का प्रभाव है।”
english: And whomever, here, on the information of a spy, he should know to be a stealer of yoke-pins, goads and the like, him he should point out of these: “This is the might of the king.”
notes: prati-ā-√diś is uncertain; "point out" is chosen, alternatives are "assign" or "attribute (to the king's might)". tam eṣām is read "him, of these" (partitive, among the seized). upadeśa is literally "instruction"; "information" is the natural sense with apasarpa (spy). śamyā = yoke-pin; pratoda = goad. The closing iti is not rendered. Reviewer: eṣām may instead be a genitive of the recipient ('point him out to these'), as paura-jānapadānām after darśayet in unit 13; who 'these' are is not stated. Literal rendering kept; a person should decide.
lines_deva: यं च-अत्र-अपसर्प.उपदेशेन शम्या.प्रतोद.आदीनाम् अपहर्तारं जानीयात् तम् एषां प्रत्यादिशेत् "एष राज्ञः प्रभावः" इति
lines_iast: yaṃ ca-atra-apasarpa.upadeśena śamyā.pratoda.ādīnām apahartāraṃ jānīyāt tam eṣāṃ pratyādiśet "eṣa rājñaḥ prabhāvaḥ" iti

words.gloss: old thieves, cowherds, hunters, men with dog-packs
having abundant kūṭa, money, raw materials and goods

hindi: पुराने चोर, गोपालक, व्याध और कुत्तों के समूह वाले, वन के चोरों और आटविकों में प्रविष्ट होकर, बहुत कूट, धन, कुप्य और भाण्ड वाले सार्थों, व्रजों और गाँवों में इनसे आक्रमण करवाएँ।
english: Old thieves, cowherds, hunters and men with dog-packs, having entered among forest thieves and forest chiefs, should make these attack in caravans, cattle-stations and villages having abundant kūṭa, money, raw materials and goods.
notes: kūṭa is kept untranslated: it could be "false, fraudulent" (with hiraṇya) or a separate item; the sense is not settled. The compound purāṇa-cora-… is read as a dvandva list; alternative: purāṇa qualifies only cora ("old thieves", "former thieves"). śva-gaṇin literally "possessing a pack of dogs". The long bahuvrīhi prabhūta-…-bhāṇḍa agrees with the following sārtha-vraja-grāmeṣu. abhiyojayeyuḥ is the causative of abhi-√yuj (to attack); "these" (the forest thieves and chiefs) are made to attack; the target is not stated beyond the places. kupya = raw materials (glossary).
lines_deva: पुराण.चोर.गो.पालक.व्याध.श्व.गणिनश् च वन.चोर.आटविकान् अनुप्रविष्टाः प्रभूत.कूट.हिरण्य.कुप्य.भाण्डेषु सार्थ.व्रज.ग्रामेष्व् एनान् अभियोजयेयुः
lines_iast: purāṇa.cora.go.pālaka.vyādha.śva.gaṇinaś ca vana.cora.āṭavikān anupraviṣṭāḥ prabhūta.kūṭa.hiraṇya.kupya.bhāṇḍeṣu sārtha.vraja.grāmeṣv enān abhiyojayeyuḥ

hindi: आक्रमण होने पर गुप्त सेनाओं से मरवा दें, अथवा मदन-विष मिले मार्ग-भोजन से।
english: At the attack they should have [them] killed by secret forces, or by road-food mixed with madana poison.
notes: madana is a name (kept); rasa is rendered "poison" per the glossary for poisoning contexts (alternative: juice, essence). pathy-adana is read as pathi + adana, "food on the road"; alternative pathya-adana is not supported by the printed y. The objects of ghātayeyuḥ are not stated ("them" is bracketed in English).
lines_deva: अभियोगे गूढ.बलैर् घातयेयुः, मदन.रस.युक्तेन वा पथ्य्.अदनेन
lines_iast: abhiyoge gūḍha.balair ghātayeyuḥ, madana.rasa.yuktena vā pathy.adanena

words.gloss: those who have taken up loads of stolen goods
worn out from having gone a long way

words.gram: pres. part. pra-√svap, m. acc. pl.

hindi: अथवा जिन्होंने चोरी के माल के भार उठा रखे हैं, जो लम्बा चलकर थके हुए हैं, प्रहवणों में सो रहे हैं, या जो योग-सुरा से मत्त हैं, उन्हें पकड़वाएँ।
english: Or they should have those seized who have taken up loads of stolen goods, are worn out from having gone a long [way], are sleeping in prahavaṇas, or are intoxicated by yoga-liquor.
notes: prahavaṇa is kept untranslated (no sense guessed). loptra is rendered "stolen goods" (medium confidence; literally plunder or booty). āyata-gata-pariśrānta: āyata = long, gata = gone; "[way]" is supplied in brackets; alternative reading of āyata as "stretched out". yoga-surā as in unit 10. The listed descriptions are read as qualifying the same persons, except the last, which is introduced by vā.
lines_deva: गृहीत.लोप्त्र.भारान् आयत.गत.परिश्रान्तान् प्रस्वपतः प्रहवणेषु योग.सुरा.मत्तान् वा ग्राहयेयुः
lines_iast: gṛhīta.loptra.bhārān āyata.gata.pariśrāntān prasvapataḥ prahavaṇeṣu yoga.surā.mattān vā grāhayeyuḥ

words.gram: pres. part. caus. √kṛ, m. nom. sg.

words.gloss: among the dwellers of the country

hindi: और पहले की तरह इन्हें पकड़कर समाहर्ता प्रस्तुत करे, राष्ट्र के निवासियों में राजा की सर्वज्ञता की घोषणा करवाता हुआ।
english: And, having seized these as before, the Collector should present [them], causing the proclamation of the king's omniscience among the dwellers of the country.
notes: prarūpayet (pra-√rūp, causative) is rendered "present" (alternative: exhibit, declare); its object is not stated ("them" is bracketed in English). pūrvavat refers back to the procedure of units 13 and 14. The two printed lines form one sentence.
